facts.text: CompactERAS is an ophyd Device documented as a CompactERAS Soft IOC; the class docstring names the channels through the CH{0..4} attributes and the class declares the CH1 to CH4 Channel components
Channel.voltage is an EpicsSignalRO Component on the Voltage suffix and Channel.current is an EpicsSignalRO Component on the Current suffix
CompactERAS.CH1 to CH4 are Channel Components with the CH1: to CH4: suffixes
version reads the Version PV and supported_devices reads the DevicesUsed PV, both as string signals
sampling_rate reads the SamplingRate PV and acquisition_bandwidth reads the AcquisitionBandwidth PV
verifyVersion reads version.get() and returns False when the read raises ConnectionTimeoutError
getSupportedDevices splits the supported_devices reply on single spaces

measures.description: Soft IOC version string read from the Version PV
measures.name: version

measures.description: Space-separated list of devices reported by the DevicesUsed PV
measures.name: supported_devices

measures.description: Measure a DC or RMS voltage on a declared channel or terminal pair and return the value with its sampling timestamp and measurement range.

inputs.description: Channel name, one of CH1 to CH4

safe_state.description: unchanged: the package only reads the four CompactERAS channels and never writes a setpoint, a Channel/Scale setting or an acquisition command; an e-stop engages the endpoint's software latch and stops nothing physical
